name: Quiz Started
description: User taps 'let's start' on the quiz intro screen.

name: Quiz Completed
description: User finishes all quiz steps and a color season prior is determined.

name: Selfie Uploaded
description: User selects or captures a selfie photo for color analysis.

name: Selfie Analysis Completed
description: AI selfie analysis returns a successful color season result.

name: Selfie Analysis Failed
description: AI selfie analysis returns a retake error or hard rejection.

name: Account Created
description: User successfully creates a new account after completing the quiz.

name: User Signed In
description: User successfully signs in to an existing account.

name: Item Scanned
description: User submits an item photo and receives a palette match verdict.

name: Scan Failed
description: Item scan returns an error before a verdict is produced.

name: Paywall Opened
description: Scan credit paywall modal is shown when user runs out of free scans.

name: Wardrobe Item Saved
description: User saves a scanned clothing item to their wardrobe.

name: Color Analysis Completed
description: Server-side selfie analysis route returns a successful result.

name: Report Upgrade Initiated
description: User taps the unlock report button on the profile page.
